ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first preventive health assistant built for rural frontline health workers to automate vaccination schedules and outbreak tracking.
ideas.problem_statement: New platforms and approaches to support mental health and low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery in rural areas.
ideas.title: AshaVoice
ideas.track: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets underserved communities with a zero-friction voice interface, mirroring proven rural health impact patterns.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade rPPG contactless heart rate and stress monitoring web app that runs entirely on low-end smartphones without extra hardware.
ideas.problem_statement: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery and tools that use health data analytics to identify and predict health risks.
ideas.title: VitalPulse Edge
ideas.track: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced computer vision with zero-cost deployment, fulfilling the need for accessible tech in resource-constrained environments.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered risk stratification tool that analyzes longitudinal patient vital metrics to predict and flag early indicators of mental health crises.
ideas.problem_statement: Tools that use health data analytics to identify and predict health risks and new platforms and approaches to support mental health.
ideas.title: NeuroGuard AI
ideas.track: Tools that use health data analytics to identify and predict health risks
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on predictive health analytics, a core stated priority for Johns Hopkins collaboration judges.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent LLM system designed to audit insurance prior authorization denials for systemic bias against low-income patient demographics.
ideas.problem_statement: Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare to reduce costs and improve administrative accessibility.
ideas.title: ClaimAudit Agent
ideas.track: Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cutting-edge agentic workflows to a real administrative bottleneck, matching winning patterns from top-tier health hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An emotion-aware speech-to-speech conversational platform providing immediate, low-latency coping strategies and psychological triage for remote users.
ideas.problem_statement: New platforms and approaches to support mental health.
ideas.title: MindBridge Speech
ideas.track: New platforms and approaches to support mental health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an empathetic, real-time voice experience that directly addresses the global mental health access gap.
